graphics.name: stash-or-pass
graphics.prompt: A transparent die-cut emblem badge for a sports-card break livestream, bold 3D sports/esports broadcast style. It reads "STASH or PASS" in large bold beveled metallic letters, with "or" small between the two big words. Use the provided HeadCheckCards logo as a high-fidelity brand reference: if it contains a mascot or character, re-pose that exact character into the action; if it is a wordmark, carry its finish and lettering. Integrate the HeadCheckCards name only if it reads well, spelled EXACTLY as in the logo and drawn in the brand's own lettering — never a pasted crop. Show a mid-action figure holding one trading card up to keep and tossing another aside. Primary color bold red #F83A3A, secondary deep black #141415, with bright chrome, white and silver highlights and a glossy gradient drawing the eye to the lettering (build strong light/dark contrast — never flat single-color). Dynamic split composition: a green up-arrow "stash" cue on one side, a red "pass" cue on the other; sparks, motion dust, angular shards. Transparent background, die-cut emblem only, clean alpha edge, no rectangular backdrop. Bold 3D beveled lettering, glossy chrome and color, sharp edges, dramatic depth and rim lighting, explosive shards, layered composition, premium merch-quality, NOT flat and NOT hand-sketched; one clear focal hierarchy (game name first), centered with padding, readable from a distance.
